notes.title: 《The Adventures of MICOCO》demo version is now released on Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Good evening, we are PantyParrot and this is out new game, [i]The Adventures of Micoco[/i]!
The demo for this new puzzle RPG has been released for Steam Next Fest!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42277229/a43aff0afee012e65c69199d1d0beb80bf234256.jpg[/img]

[b]Game Description[/b]

One day, the adventurer Micoco discovered an assignment posted by a faraway village.The village leader needed someone to take care of the horde of monsters that had invaded their settlement. Micoco took on the assignment, not knowing she'd be biting off more than she could chew.

Players Beware: This game features some pretty hardcore themes.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42277229/5f9b9b809658b22db699c20678c656de56bc8bde.jpg[/img]

[i]The Adventures of Micoco[/i] is a simple exploration game without complicated combat or stats. You must guide Micoco through the ruins to uncover the mystery behind the appearance of the tentacles. Of course, when there's tentacles, theres THAT. Make too many mistakes, and several mind-breaking tentacle-based endings await Micoco.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42277229/f57adb33f4ba7ba50fff36544ab6cf389a13db8d.png[/img]

If you felt at home with the lovey-dovey atmosphere in [i]Kaiju Princess[/i], [i]The Adventures of Micoco might[/i] not be for you. However, if you're an open-minded individual with varied tastes, then contratulations! You will enjoy this exciting union between a mass of sticky tentacles and a headstrong adventurer. 

The tentacles might be sticky but we have designed the puzzles to be intuitive and straightforward. Attentive players will get lots of hints, which will allow them to traverse the tentacle-laden halls with (relative) ease.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42277229/5b9d8dc4eda771f16f9832350fb878c6a7da76a7.jpg[/img]

The current Demo contains [b]4 lewd H-scenes[/b] for your enjoyment. The full game will contain a total of [b]10 H-scenes[/b]. Will Micoco solve the mystery of the tentacles and complete her assignment?

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42277229/3cd7e1ca82fdfbf0cc6ca8df5e6198eb0fabddff.png[/img]

We also have an important disclaimer to make. [b]This game does not feature any animated CGs[/b]. You might be thinking "Why would an H-game in 2022 still feature static CGs?" and that's because this game was independently created by one of the members of our team. The Adventures of Micoco will be their first indie game, so there were restraints on the funding and the personnel available to work on the game.
It might not be the longest game, but we hope you'll understand and enjoy this game for its complete gameplay experience.

To cap off, our team is currently working on the sequel to [i]Kaiju Princess[/i], in which we hope to bring you more wholesome kaiju content.

Please consider following and supporting us! Thank you!
